questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. The art of effective speaking

Key Points

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A short interesting or amusing story
questions.questionHtml:

A short interesting or amusing story
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Anecdote'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Anecdote'.
  • It means 'a short interesting story about a real person or event'. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या घटना के विषय में रोचक लघुकथा; कि़स्‍सा चुटकला, लतीफ़ा)
    • Example: He told me some anecdotes.
       

Correct Answer: Anecdote.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Legend: an old story that may or may not be true. [प्राचीन कथा (जिसका सत्‍य या असत्‍य होना प्रासंगिक नहीं); आख्‍यान, किंवदंती, दंतकथा, लोककथा]
    • Myth: a story from past times, especially one about gods and men of courage. Myths often explain natural or historical events. [मिथक, पौराणिक कथा (जो विशेषतया देवताओं और वीर पुरुषों के विषय में होती हैं और जिनमें प्रायः प्राकृतिक या ऐतिहासिक घटनाओं का वर्णन होता है)]
    • Epic: very long and exciting. (बहुत लंबा और उत्तेजना भरा)

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Go back over the same route that one has just taken
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Go back over the same route that one has just taken
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Retrace'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Retrace'.
  • It means 'to repeat a past journey, series of events, etc. [(ठीक उसी रास्‍ते) लौटना, पिछली बातों को दोहराना, आदि]'
    • Example: If you retrace your steps, you might see where you dropped the ticket.
       

Correct Answer: Retrace.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Detour: a longer route from one place to another that you take in order to avoid something/somebody or in order to see or do something. (किसी चीज़ से बचने के लिए लम्बे रास्ते का अनुसरण, घुमावदार या चक्‍करदार रास्‍ता)
    • Return: to come or go back to a place. (कहीं पहुँचना या लौटना)
    • Reroute: send by or along a different route. (किसी भिन्न मार्ग से या उसके साथ भेजें)

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Comparison between things that have similar features

let's look at the other options,

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Release someone from a duty or obligation
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Release someone from a duty or obligation
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Exonerate"

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Banish- to send someone away, especially from their country, and not allow them to come back
      • Example- He was banished to an uninhabited island for a year.
    • Expel- to force someone to leave a school, organization, or country
      • Example- The new government has expelled all foreign diplomats.
    • Dismiss- to decide that something or someone is not important and not worth considering
      • Example- I think he'd dismissed me as an idiot within five minutes of meeting me.
    • Exonerate- to show or state that someone or something is not guilty of something
      • Example- The report exonerated the crew from all responsibility for the collision.
  • Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is Option 4 i.e. Exonerate.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Pictures given in a book for the purpose of explaining things

Key Points  
  

  • Let's look at the meaning of the marked option:
    Word Meaning
    Illustration a picture in a book, magazine, etc. given as an example that explains or proves something. (किसी पुस्तक, पत्रिका आदि में उदाहरण के रूप में दिया गया चित्र जो किसी बात की व्याख्या या सिद्ध करता हो)

    Demonstration the act of showing someone how to do something, or how something works. (किसी को कुछ कैसे करना है, या कुछ कैसे काम करता है, यह दिखाने की क्रिया)
  • Hence, from the given meanings, we find that 'Illustration' is the correct one-word substitute.
  • So, the correct answer is option 3.
 

Correct one-word substitute: Illustration.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. The study of ancient writings and scriptures

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Requiring exceptional skill or caution in performance or handling
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Requiring exceptional skill or caution in performance or handling
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Tricky'.

Key Points

  • Here are the meanings of the words: 
    • Blunt (फूला हुआ) - not sharp or pointed; lacking sharpness or forcefulness.
    • Tricky (चालाक) - requiring skill or caution because of difficulty, complexity, or deception; likely to change unexpectedly or be difficult to deal with.
    • Sustainable (सतत) - able to be maintained at a certain rate or level; conserving an ecological balance by avoiding depletion of natural resources.
    • Abstract (अमूर्त) - existing in thought or as an idea but not having a physical or concrete existence; theoretical; conceptual.
  • Among these options, the most appropriate one-word substitute for the given group of words is: Tricky.
  • Explanation: 
    • The phrase "requiring exceptional skill or caution in performance or handling" suggests a situation that is difficult, intricate, or requires careful handling.
    • "Tricky" perfectly encapsulates this idea, as it denotes something that is challenging or likely to cause problems due to its complexity or deceptive nature.
  • Options 1 (Blunt), 3 (Sustainable), and 4 (Abstract) do not convey the idea of requiring exceptional skill or caution in performance or handling. Therefore, option 2, "Tricky," is the most appropriate choice.
